name: kata
description: A self-evolving knowledge system for AI-paired builders. Built on Karpathy's LLM-Wiki principle, the CORE is a self-closing ingest/synthesis loop + auto-dreaming that resurfaces frozen pages when their relevance returns. Phase 1 reach (current): AI-paired engineering — compile project business semantics so agents read project conventions before they write code. Phase 2 (designed): team spec authoring + dispute resolution. Builders inherit a kata, adapt it to their project, transcend the form. 14 skills (init, import, ingest, search, graph, tier, digest, query, lint, config, dream, watch, sync, spec). Spec History Management (v1.13) in Phase 0+2 — kata-internal preflight + relationship-declaration enforcement on ingest. Cross-source authoring is served by wiki-import (bulk human ingest) or v1.12 cross-wiki federation (planned). Multi-CLI session ingest in flight (v1.11).
